dz: 由乔治·弗里德里克·汉德尔出演的歌剧"阿格里皮纳"(Agrippina)在威尼斯首演.

t: 第二次阿南德普尔战役期间，奥朗则布的两名将领瓦齐尔汗和扎贝尔达斯特汗将古鲁·戈宾德·辛格的两个…
te: In the Second Battle of Anandpur, Aurangzeb's two generals, Wazir Khan and Zaberdast Khan executed two children of Guru…
dz: 第二次阿南德普尔战役期间，奥朗则布的两名将领瓦齐尔汗和扎贝尔达斯特汗将古鲁·戈宾德·辛格的两个孩子——8岁的佐拉瓦尔·辛格与5岁的法塔赫·辛格——活埋进墙中处死。
de: Second Battle of Anandpur: In the Second Battle of Anandpur, Aurangzeb's two generals, Wazir Khan and Zaberdast Khan executed two children of Guru Gobind Singh, Zorawar Singh aged eight and Fateh Singh aged five, by burying them alive into a wall.

te: An army of 4,000 to 5,000 soldiers raised by David of Burgundy, Bishop of Utrecht, attacks an armed mob of people from …
dz: 韦斯特布罗克战役:一支由勃艮第的大卫(英语:David of Burgundy, Bishop of Utle)所起的由4000至5000名军人组成的军队,从附近的乌特勒支袭击了一群想为屠杀韦斯特布罗克居民报仇的武装暴徒.
de: Battle of Westbroek: An army of 4,000 to 5,000 soldiers raised by David of Burgundy, Bishop of Utrecht, attacks an armed mob of people from nearby Utrecht who were trying to avenge the massacre of the inhabitants of Westbroek.

t: 贝伦加尔一世被伦巴第的领主选举为意大利国王. 他在帕维亚加冕为伦巴第铁冠.
te: Berengar I is elected as king of Italy by the lords of Lombardy. He is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy at Pavia.
dz: 贝伦加尔一世被伦巴第的领主选举为意大利国王. 他在帕维亚加冕为伦巴第铁冠.
de: Berengar I is elected as king of Italy by the lords of Lombardy. He is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy at Pavia.
